resolved_translation_findings.issue: Exercise1 degrees was translated only as 度, contrary to literal unit preservation convention

source_issues.issue: Three dependent vectors need not span a plane; they may span a line or zero space. The concrete v1/v2/v3 example is a plane because v1 and v2 are independent.
source_issues.translation_handling: Preserved the source general claim and correct concrete example separately.

source_issues.issue: rank = min(m,n) does not guarantee unique least-squares weights for a wide underdetermined matrix, and full rank alone does not guarantee good conditioning. Singular-value size must be interpreted with scaling/relative conditioning.
source_issues.translation_handling: Full-rank, unique-solution and 良态 claims faithfully retained; no silent correction.

source_issues.issue: Raw dot products depend on magnitudes as well as direction; positive/negative signs do not imply exact same/opposite directions. Perpendicularity does not in general establish semantic unrelatedness.
source_issues.translation_handling: Source prose and protected direction table preserved.

source_issues.issue: Standard attention query-key scores are not the ordinary orthogonal projection of a query onto each key; fitted observations in least squares are the projection, whereas coefficient vectors are not themselves that projected observation vector.
source_issues.translation_handling: Source projection analogy retained; actor/target not swapped.

source_issues.issue: Gram-Schmidt is one QR construction; numerical QR commonly uses Householder reflections. Stability comparison with Gaussian elimination is unqualified and classical Gram-Schmidt can lose orthogonality.
source_issues.translation_handling: Source QR explanation and stability statement retained.

source_issues.issue: Displayed Python snippets omit some empty/mismatched/zero-vector guards; project(a,b) assumes nonzero b. Displayed Matrix has no rank() method although exercise 5 calls one; this statement is limited to the displayed class, not the separate complete implementation. Julia excerpt uses dot operator without showing LinearAlgebra import; Julia execution was not available to this review.
source_issues.translation_handling: All protected snippets unchanged; no runtime success claim.

source_issues.issue: Rank at most 16 constrains the image/column space of the 4096x4096 update matrix; the update matrix itself is not simply a vector in a 4096-dimensional space. Parameter counts 16M/131K are approximate source shorthand.
source_issues.translation_handling: Preserved dimensions, numbers and original explanatory claim.

source_issues.issue: Matrices are the whole model / every layer is matrix multiplication / tensors are vectors with autodiff are pedagogical overgeneralizations.
source_issues.translation_handling: Preserved rhetorical scope rather than introducing new qualifications.
